meta.promptText: India mein shaadi ke liye budget mein online konsi sarees kharidun?

response.text:
Bilkul 😊 Agar **shaadi ke liye budget mein online saree** chahiye, toh ₹500–₹2,500 mein kaafi achhe options mil rahe hain. Current listings mein Myntra par ₹500–₹1,000 ke range mein Banarasi, georgette, silk-blend aur Kanjeevaram-style sarees bhi hain. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/saree-below-1000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 💕 Mere hisaab se ye styles dekho

**1. Silk-blend / Semi-Kanjeevaram — ₹800–₹2,000**  
Shaadi ke traditional function ke liye sabse classy option. Gold zari border + jewel tones (rani pink, bottle green, maroon, purple) expensive look dete hain.

### [Bridal Kanchi Semi Silk Saree]()
*₹1,699*

### [Semi Kanchi Silk Saree]()
*₹1,900*

### [Bridal Semi Silk Saree]()
*₹1,500*

**2. Organza — ₹600–₹1,600**  
Reception, engagement ya sangeet ke liye lightweight aur modern. Pastel pink, lavender, sage green ya powder blue mein bahut pretty lagegi.

### [Yashika Organza Saree]()
*₹761*

### [Sidhidata Golden Organza Saree]()
*₹749*

### [Lorofy Silk Blend Organza Saree]()
*₹650*

**3. Banarasi / Zari — ₹500–₹1,500**  
Agar **“budget mein rich look”** chahiye, ye meri favourite category hai. Myntra par abhi ₹449–₹999 ke aas-paas bhi Banarasi/zari options listed hain. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/saree-below-1000?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

udget Banarasi and zari sarees for Indian weddings under ₹1500

**4. Georgette / Chiffon — ₹600–₹1,800**  
Sangeet ya cocktail-type function ke liye comfortable. Sequin/border wali saree lo toh simple blouse + statement earrings ke saath kaafi glamorous lagegi. Wedding-guest guides bhi lightweight georgette styles ko ₹3,000 ke andar recommend kar rahe hain. [hotdeals360.com](https://hotdeals360.com/fashion/wedding-guest-guide-elegant-ethnic-sets-and-sarees-under-3-000-10938544?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 💰 Agar mera budget hota:
- **₹1,000 tak:** Banarasi/zari ya embellished organza
- **₹1,000–₹1,500:** Semi-silk/Kanjeevaram-style
- **₹1,500–₹2,500:** Better-quality silk-blend, tissue ya organza
- **₹2,500–₹3,000:** Thodi premium-looking wedding/reception saree

**Tip:** ₹400–₹500 wali sarees mil jaati hain, lekin actual shaadi ke liye main ₹800–₹1,500 range target karungi—fabric, fall aur finishing generally safer bet hoti hai. [www.myntra.com](https://www.myntra.com/sarees-below-500?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum **apna budget (e.g. ₹1000/₹1500/₹2000), age aur shaadi ka function (haldi/sangeet/wedding/reception)** bata do, main **exact online sarees ke 8–10 options** dhoondh kar de sakti hoon.
